messages:
mike: Heads up — aiming to cut v1.12.0 tonight around 22:30 PT. This will include API, runtime, console, and SDK bumps. Quick checklist before we cut:
- API: minor bump, changelog entry already in REVIEW
- runtime: patch w/ perf fix and new quant flag
- console: UI tweak + changelog
- sdks: clients need new version and changelog metadata

ana: ETA on final API PR merge? I can hold the tag if needed.

jess: API PR (#412) is green, just waiting on_review from @cheng for the auth tweak.

cheng: on it, will review in next 20m. If I see nothing blocking I'll approve.

mike: thanks. When we tag, please do not push any new commits to release branches. We'll cut tags from main after the changelog is frozen.

sam: for SDKs, I have three PRs staged: python, js, go. They all include the new client surface. Wanted to confirm version scheme — semver minor (1.12.0) across the board?

mike: yes semver minor. Runtime patch (1.11.2 -> 1.11.3) was considered but since runtime has small breaking telemetry rename it's minor too. So align to 1.12.0 for all runtime & infra repos.

jess: changelog template I'm using: ```
## 1.12.0 (YYYY-MM-DD)
- Added: feature X
- Fixed: perf regression in Y
- Changed: telemetry field rename
``` 
Linking PRs under each bullet.

ana: release-bot, can you open the release branch once tags go up? @release-bot

release-bot: will do. When I see tags pushed with prefix `v1.12.0` I will create `release/1.12.0` branches in api, runtime, console, sdks and trigger the release pipeline.

cheng: minor note on builds — runtime + console need the new shared proto schema. Make sure proto tag is included. Command we'll use:
```
git tag -a v1.12.0 -m "v1.12.0"
git push origin v1.12.0
```

sam: Publishing plan for SDKs: tag -> CI builds wheels/npm packages -> upload to internal registry -> wait 30m for integration smoke tests -> roll external publish. I'll open a PR to the release doc with timestamps.

mike: timeline: aim tag at 22:30 PT, branching by 22:40, SDK publishes start 23:00. If anything blocks merge before 22:10 so we can triage.

ana: merging API now. tagging in ~15.

jess: console PR merged.

cheng: approved and merged API.

sam: kicking off SDK CI builds now; will post failures here if any.

release-bot: created release branches in api/runtime/console/sdks and triggered pipelines. CI matrix started.

mike: if anyone hits a CI blocker after tag, post short summary here and we'll decide hotfix vs rollback. :thumbsup:
